result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I haven't added a test for this change, and the `Landscape*` tests I ran in `codeanalyzer` passed.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. A contributor matched by no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Contributors with a blank latest-commit date count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank dates. Configured teams are untouched and keep all their members.

The team's repository and commit totals are built only from the members added to it, so dormant contributors no longer count there either. If every unmatched contributor is dormant, the remainder team is left out entirely.
